patches.value: GPEucl k abbreviates EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k), inspected in PiL2.lean: EuclideanSpace is PiLp 2, where 2 is the L2 norm exponent, not a dimension; Fin k is the finite coordinate index. EuclideanSpace.dist_eq/dist_sq_eq give the square root of the sum of squared real coordinate distances. WithLp.toLp 2 wraps coordinate functions and Fin.snoc appends the last real coordinate; GPhead uses castSucc and Fin.last k is the final index in Fin(k+1). GPproduct E is exactly the set of vectors whose first n coordinates lie in E and whose last coordinate lies in Icc 0 1; T001 checks its metric and reconstruction identities. No alternative product norm appears. GPcover uses arbitrary countable ℕ-indexed sets, allowing finite covers by empty padding, with Metric.ediam (the supremum of pairwise edists) bounded by ofReal δ. GPcost uses ENNReal real powers and nonnegative extended sums; for s>0 empty/singleton costs are zero and infinite diameters have infinite cost. GPcontent and GPmass are exactly D003's infimum and positive-scale supremum, rather than assuming equality with native measure. T002 proves the native comparison both for Euclidean sets and for the real line used in D006. dimH is the inspected native ENNReal supremum over nonnegative real exponents of infinite native measure; top is infinity, and no toReal truncation of dimension is used. ofReal maps a real to its nonnegative part; all scale/cost-threshold conversions have positivity guards. A comparison dimH A < ofReal q forces q>0, so it is exactly the source real-exponent condition q>dim_H A even when dimH A may be infinite. Finite diameter toReal conversions occur only after GPcover bounds them by finite ofReal δ. At native critical-exponent calls s>0 identifies s.toNNReal with s in both ℝ and ENNReal. Lebesgue integration uses the actual real-line volume and measurable interval indicators; covering sets remain arbitrary. H001-H003 are retained, no M or Audit A note is a premise. All library applications remain proof obligations, not accepted definitions. The inspected ENNReal.tsum_eq_iSup_sum identifies ∑' with the supremum of finite subsums, exactly D002's convention, so no summability assumption is encoded.
